name: Proxima Divide
detailed_description:
Overview

Proxima Divide is a first-person sci-fi survival game that challenges players to endure, adapt, and uncover meaning in the aftermath of catastrophe. Set 50 years in the future, you awaken alone after a crash landing near a silent research outpost on a distant alien world. With oxygen running low and no sign of the colonists, survival becomes your first priority—but not your last.

As you scavenge for resources, repair broken systems, and confront hostile AI, a deeper mystery begins to surface—one that suggests the colonists may have encountered something beyond comprehension. At the heart of it all lies the Proxima Divide: a threshold between survival and transcendence, between what we know and what lies just beyond.

Key Features

  • Immersive Survival Mechanics
    Manage oxygen, hunger, and exhaustion while navigating a hostile environment. Every decision matters.

  • Crafting & Resource Management
    Gather raw materials, refine them into components, and craft tools, weapons, and survival gear.

  • Narrative-Driven Exploration
    Discover logs, terminals, and environmental storytelling that reveal the fate of the colonists and the alien presence.

  • Tense First-Person Combat
    Defend yourself with scavenged weapons against rogue AI and environmental threats.

  • Puzzle & Repair Systems
    Solve keypad puzzles, restore power, and repair critical systems to progress through the outpost.

  • Atmospheric World Design
    Explore a richly detailed alien landscape with dynamic lighting, audio cues, and environmental storytelling.

  • Emergent Storytelling
    Your survival journey becomes its own narrative—shaped by your choices, discoveries, and resilience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
